title: Self-Hosted Cloudflare Tunnel Dashboard
description: A custom internal dashboard for managing Cloudflare Zero Trust tunnels across multiple homelab nodes. Features real-time metrics and config deployment.

title: Kubernetes GitOps Playground
description: An automated provisioning script suite for setting up a local k3s cluster integrated with ArgoCD and sealed-secrets. Designed to bootstrap a production-like environment on a NUC cluster in under 5 minutes.

title: Traefik Middleware Library
description: A curated, tested collection of Traefik middlewares — rate limiting, security headers, and auth-forward chains — versioned as reusable Helm values.

title: NixOS Dotfiles
description: Declarative system configurations and dotfiles using Nix flakes. Currently paused while evaluating home-manager vs standalone configurations.
